title: This manga made me re-read it 3 times
hookText: Not because of the fights, but because of the choices the characters make in critical moments

highlights.title: The Art
highlights.description: Every panel looks like a painting. Inoue uses ink wash techniques that make fight scenes feel alive.

highlights.title: The Growth
highlights.description: Musashi starts as a killer and slowly learns what it means to be strong vs what it means to be invincible.

highlights.title: The Philosophy
highlights.description: It asks: after you become the strongest, then what? The answer is not what you expect.

targetAudience: People who want more than just fighting
outroMessage: Read it. You will not regret it.
